title: Replace BGZF leaf functions (bgzf_is_bgzf, bgzf_seek) and plan full BGZF Rust module
description: Replace 2 BGZF FFI leaf functions: bgzf_is_bgzf (11 lines, magic header check) and bgzf_seek (16 lines, position management). These are the first steps toward a full BGZF Rust replacement which would unlock faidx, tbx, hts_open/close, and all file I/O. Consider using the flate2 crate or referencing the noodles crate's BGZF implementation. Complexity: easy.
